content: Be as simple as you can be; you will be astonished to see how uncomplicated and happy your life can become.
author: Paramahansa Yogananda
explanation:
We complicate our lives with elaborate social masks, artificial needs, excessive possessions, and intricate ego strategies to impress people we don't even like. This endless complexity drains our vital energy and produces chronic anxiety. When you strip away the pretension and return to plain living, high thinking, honest speech, and simple desires, a fountain of spontaneous joy bubbles to the surface.

Simplicity is the ultimate sophistication of the soul.
practicalInsight: Declutter one physical or mental area of your life today: clear off your workspace or decline an unnecessary commitment with polite simplicity.
reflectionPrompt: In what area of your life have you created unnecessary drama and complexity where plain honesty and simplicity would bring peace?
